# vcp_project_consumption_resources (Data Source)

Reads what the project was charged over a period, broken down by root resource (a server, a network, a cluster, …), optionally for one service.

The period is counted in the partner's time zone (`time_zone`) and both ends are inclusive. It may be at most 366 days long.

~> While `is_final` is `false` the period reaches today and its amounts still grow as the day is billed: a plan run later can read a different `total`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# What each vStack resource has been charged this month so far.
data "vcp_project_consumption_resources" "vstack" {
  service = "vstack"
}

# Every resource charged in October, largest amount first.
data "vcp_project_consumption_resources" "october" {
  from = "2026-10-01"
  to   = "2026-10-31"
}

# id and name are null for resources that have none, hence the fallbacks.
output "october_by_resource" {
  value = [
    for r in data.vcp_project_consumption_resources.october.resources :
    "${r.type} ${coalesce(r.name, r.id, "unnamed")}: ${r.total}"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `from` (String) First day of the period, `YYYY-MM-DD`, inclusive. Defaults to the first day of the current month.
- `service` (String) Lists the resources of this service only: `vstack`, `vmware`, `kubernetes`, `vpn`, `cloud_director`, `ssl_certificates`, `unoc_v1`, `unoc_v2`, `monitoring`, `object_storage`, `cdn`, `llm`, `managed_servers`, `vdi`, `streaming`. Unset lists every service.
- `to` (String) Last day of the period, `YYYY-MM-DD`, inclusive. Defaults to today. Must not be earlier than `from`.

### Read-Only

- `currency` (String) Currency of the amounts — the project currency, as in `vcp_project`.
- `is_final` (Boolean) `false` while `to` is not earlier than today: the last day is still being billed.
- `resources` (Attributes List) Amount per root resource, largest first. Only resources charged in the period are listed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))
- `time_zone` (String) IANA time zone of the partner, in which the period dates are counted.
- `total` (Number) Amount charged to the project over the period; the sum of the listed `resources`, so with `service` set it covers that service only.

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Identifier of the resource in the API, always a string: the `id` of a `vcp_server`, or the `id` of a `vcp_vmware_server` or `vcp_vmware_network` written in decimal. Null when the resource cannot be addressed through the API: a vStack gateway, most kinds other than servers, networks and clusters, or a resource that no longer exists.
- `name` (String) Name of the resource as the panel shows it in the charge details, on the last day of the period it was charged. Null when the resource has no name of its own.
- `service` (String) Billed service the resource belongs to, from the same set as `service`.
- `total` (Number) Amount charged for the resource over the period.
- `type` (String) Kind of the resource: `vstack_server`, `vstack_edge`, `vmware_server`, `vmware_server_template`, `vmware_network`, `kubernetes_cluster`, `vpn_server`, `cloud_director_vdc`, `ssl_certificate`, `unoc_v1_company`, `unoc_v2_rdp_user`, `unoc_v2_web_user`, `unoc_v2_terminal_server`, `unoc_v2_additional_infobases`, `unoc_v2_additional_infobase_size`, `unoc_v2_infobase_backup`, `monitoring_host`, `object_storage`, `cdn_site`, `cdn_s3_resource`, `cdn_vod`, `stream`, `llm_access_key`, `managed_servers_subscription`, `manual_billing`. New kinds are added to the set over time.
